Hanno Eco-tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-chokotto-tenranzan/

Walk with a guide and discover natural changes you might miss on an ordinary walk. This is a short, easy-to-enjoy tour. Please feel welcome to join.

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for returning participants; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide fee and insurance)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Kojima Tsubasa (Hanno City Eco-tourism Citizen Guides Association, Wildlife Section)

【What to bring】
Drink, rain gear, backpack or similar (something that keeps both hands free is recommended), towel, insect repellent spray
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
